feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 May 2026 10:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 19 May 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure northwest of Ireland, moving eastwards, with associated fronts and troughs crossing the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, veering west or southwest 4 or 5 tonight, backing southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, decreasing 4 or 5 early in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but occasionally rough in southern and central parts at first.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at first. Otherwise mainly fair, although possibly hazy.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 overnight and at first on Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but slight in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Rain for a time, then a risk of mist and fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.
